evidence.note: shipped sleeve re-run through Engine on its out-of-sample year: next-open fills, stop-first intrabar, 3 ATR Chandelier trail, 18-bar time exit, 3% risk, 95% max position, drawdown switch off (0.99), 10 bps fee + 5 bps slippage a side. Parameters were selected on 2024-11-28..2025-11-27 (best of 26 configs, +45.4%) and never fitted to this window. Two-year cross-check: +123.2% / -16.6% / 47 trades against ENA hold -85.7%; the dry-run replay reads +107.9% / -16.6% / 45 trades on its 730-day window at the service's risk flags. Both the dry-run replay and the deploy loop are running as of 2026-11-28: the bot was held back until the deploy loop could ratchet the Chandelier trail (commit 3c8c68e), so the deployed exit rule is the measured one.
